# Canonical Catalog V3 media

These files are source assets for the generated `dist/assets/media/catalog-v3/` directory. They are restored by `src/media-preflight.mjs` before product-page validation.

- `ga-power-transformers.webp`: 35 / 66 / 110 / 220 kV GA reference montage
- `ga-distribution-renewable.webp`: distribution and renewable transformer GA montage
- `manufacturing-overview.webp`: manufacturing overview reference
- `testing-220kv-lab.webp`: transformer test laboratory reference
- `renewable-projects.webp`: renewable project reference montage
- `renewable-application-montage.webp`: renewable application montage

Final project drawings remain subject to engineering confirmation.
